notes.text: The author continues the description of a local ordered cylindrical stratification. He describes Γ(d)=Σ^<(d+1) through a relative Cartesian power of Γ₀ with images of lower powers removed, then speaks of ordered sequences of germs of codimension-one strata. He writes the relation numbered (35), Γ′(d) ≃ S_d × Γ(d), with the ornamental form of S left typographically doubtful. These are statements of the manuscript; they were not independently proved or checked.

The lower paragraph discusses a relative total order on Γ₀ over Σ. The author writes conditions involving Γ₁, its superscript-s counterpart, a union covering the complement of the diagonal, and an empty intersection. He describes a section involving Sym² and writes a transitivity requirement in diagram (36), followed by se factorise par Γ₁. The marginal note calls Γ₁ the graph of x<y. These claims and descriptions are attributed to the author; no proof of their equivalence was undertaken.

The author’s written d.ième and d′.ième forms, the separate d+1 in Γ(d)=Σ^<(d+1), and the strict comparison d′<d are all preserved. No dimensional shift or indexing convention was supplied to reconcile them. The cancelled added Γ′(d) has an unprimed argument d.

Several apparent cancellations must be separated from insertion leaders and joined handwriting. The stroke under ordonnée is continuous with its insertion leader. The state of the compressed mutuel^t-like word, of fermée, and of au remains marked in place. The author’s upper word over suffit is narrowed to tentative uniquement. The added short word after i.e. is tentatively néc.; its detached accent and stop are preserved.

In diagram (36), the first factor of the lower triple product has a crowded Σ₀-like outline with Γ₀ also possible. The transcription retains that ambiguity rather than choosing from the surrounding mathematical expectation. The first projection-index digit is overdrawn; 13/23 remains open. The two inclusion marks are written vertically and are reproduced vertically, while H paraphrases them in prose.

The upper-left 23 is in the main dark hand. The bottom-left 54 is smaller and lighter, in another unnamed hand, and is recorded as foliation. H’s page marker and editorial notes are not source prose. The lower diagonal margin has an additional final cancelled de, with no continuation supplied.

All decisions were made from the whole image, the two full-resolution halves and the listed crops. Repeated written forms were compared within the page and with the supplied notation snapshot. No mathematical calculation, proof-check or independent re-proof was used in deciding a reading.
